personal.name: Mohamed Elnagar
personal.heroSubtitle: Skilled Android Developer with hands-on experience delivering production-grade applications from concept through deployment. Proficient in Kotlin, Room, Paging, Hilt, and Firebase services.
personal.contactHeadline: I’m always open to discussing new opportunities, collaborations, or simply connecting with like-minded people. Feel free to reach out via any of the platforms below!

paragraphs: Hello! I'm Mohamed Elnagar, a skilled Android Developer dedicated to building high-performance, production-grade mobile applications.

With expertise in Kotlin, Jetpack Components, and Hilt, I specialize in delivering robust solutions from concept to deployment. I have a strong focus on Clean Architecture, MVVM, and writing maintainable, testable code.

My experience includes developing complex systems like medical record management, retail POS solutions, and productivity tools. I am passionate about continuous learning and staying ahead of modern Android development trends like Coroutines (Flow/StateFlow) and Paging.
When I'm not coding, I focus on software engineering best practices, exploring multimodule architectures, and refining user experiences through intuitive design and performance optimization.

projects.title: Fard (Islamic Productivity App)
projects.description: A comprehensive spiritual tool designed for tracking obligations and spiritual growth using Modular Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design.
features: Offline-First Data Engine with NoSQL persistence
Immersive Quran Reader with interactive progress tracking
Global Time Automation for prayer times and notifications
Background Audio System with lock-screen controls

projects.title: DrAiA (Medical Sessions App)
projects.description: An Android application developed for managing patient records, exams, diagnoses, and treatments, specifically for ophthalmology.
features: Patient record management and history tracking
Share treatments via WhatsApp as PDF or images

projects.title: OptPos (Seller Management)
projects.description: Managed sellers' activities, billing, and registration with secure Google Sign-In integration.
features: Seller activity tracking and performance metrics
Secure registration and login with Google

projects.title: Employee Attendance System
projects.description: Freelance project for streamlining employee attendance tracking with full Excel integration for data portability.
features: Detailed attendance status tracking (Present, Absent, Late)

tasks: Designed and developed two Android applications from scratch: Medical Sessions App (DrAiA) and Seller Management App (OptPos)
Maintained and enhanced an existing Optical Products Search App for medical lenses
Implemented clean, scalable solutions using multimodule architecture and product flavors
Applied Kotlin, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Room, MySQL, Paging, Coroutines, Flow, and Firebase
Enabled treatment sharing via WhatsApp as PDF or images
Developed a complete Employee Attendance Management System with Excel integration
Integrated Apache POI for importing/exporting attendance records with validation logic
Built features for check-in/out, status tracking (Present, Absent, Late), and detailed reporting
Utilized StateFlow for reactive UI updates and SafeArgs for navigation
Designed dynamic UIs with RecyclerView and custom adapters

education.intro: I hold a Bachelor's Degree from Ain Shams University and have dedicated my career to mastering mobile software engineering through intensive practical experience and continuous professional development.
